import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] ones = new long[17];

    public static long calculate(long n, int digit) {
        int sum = digit * (int)(n / ones[digit]);
        n %= ones[digit];
        if (n == 0) return sum;
        int option1 = digit + (int)calculate(ones[digit] - n, digit - 1);
        int option2 = (int)calculate(n, digit - 1);
        return sum + Math.min(option1, option2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        ones[0] = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k < 17; ++k) {
            ones[k] = ones[k - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long inputNumber = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(calculate(inputNumber, 16));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
